notes: The River Poros at Kadar: rowing east into Kadar made two overworld water rooms where the water is really Kadar's. They're removed by themselves at your next login, and no water room is made east of 58417 again.

Kadar's own river is linked to the overworld at both ends (Omi's map): the overworld Poros west of town flows into Kadar's river and back, and east of town the river's banks are The plains to the north and The Harad Road to the south. A stray link from Kadar's jetty out to the overworld water is gone.
Kadar's north docks are tied to the right water rooms for good (the two large wooden docks above the river): the map's guess by position can't link them wrongly any more.
history: The River Poros at Kadar: rowing east into Kadar made two overworld water rooms where the water is really Kadar's. They're removed by themselves at your next login, and no water room is made east of 58417 again.

Kadar's own river is linked to the overworld at both ends (Omi's map): the overworld Poros west of town flows into Kadar's river and back, and east of town the river's banks are The plains to the north and The Harad Road to the south. A stray link from Kadar's jetty out to the overworld water is gone.
Kadar's north docks are tied to the right water rooms for good (the two large wooden docks above the river): the map's guess by position can't link them wrongly any more.

The Quests window (Quests button on the menu bar, or 'qi'): areas on the left, their quests in the middle, the quest on the right. Search names (and the texts) from the box at the top; tap a 'do ...' line to send it. Your quest texts are sorted by AREA now (one folder each, no more notes/Corebound/Lhathron folders and no PDFs), the write-ups of the same quest merged into one. Quests whose area isn't known sit in 'Unknown Area': open one and tap the area it's from.

The Character sheet (Character button, or 'sheet'): your name, level, stats, experience, armour slot by slot, and what's in your hands, what you wear and what you carry, in the game's colors. Refresh sends score, i and armour; otherwise it fills itself whenever you type them. The worn-items list along the bottom is gone: a status box shows your name, what you're holding and how you see, with a Character sheet button.

Darkness and eaglesight on screen: in a room too dark to see in, the game text darkens towards its edges with a red 'Darkness' badge; with eaglesight on, a gold glow and an eagle badge remind you it's draining EP. 'sightfx off' turns the effects off, 'sight' says how you see.

Exits that are commands: 'mapx u climb rock' sends 'climb rock' and puts the room it brings on the map, up of here (or links the room already there), joined by 'climb rock'. Typing u there sends it from then on, and sp, goto and map clicks go through it. Works with 'start mapping' on too (the stock mapper never followed such commands). 'sx u climb rock' and then u does the same.
Walked somewhere the map doesn't have (a command, or a direction into an unmapped room)? A line offers [n] [ne] ... [up] [down] (or [add it east]): tap the way it lies and it's added and linked.
Fixed: the armour list stopped reading at 'ring1', so shield and waist were never updated. Faster room-name matching in look-alike areas (the Rohan Plains).

The map in 3D (Mudlet 5.1): a 2D | 3D button at the map's bottom left flips it, and the new 3D Map button on the menu bar has the views (angled, low, iso, top), turning, zoom, Mudlet's 3D styles and a pop-out map that follows you (2D and 3D at once). Typed: 'map3d'. Only the view changes; the map itself is never touched.

The 3D landscape: with 'mapbg on', the painted land stands up in 3D: hills, mountain ranges with snowy crests, forests of round tree tops, Mount Doom with its lava, Barad-dur and the Eye, Minas Morgul, Cirith Ungol, the Last Homely House. The rooms you walk stay in the low ground. 'map3d height' makes it flatter, 'map3d land off' lays it flat. It comes with the painted pictures (Update pictures).

The painted map pictures come with the updates now: the pop-up has an Update pictures button that brings Omi's newest painted land (rivers, roads, mountains, the red glows) for under the map, about 32 MB, and swaps it in for you. 'mapbg on' shows it. No more zip files for the pictures.

Fixed: with 'start mapping' on, every 'l' or 'look' put the stock mapper one move behind (T2T's look shows no room title, so the mapper kept waiting for one), so new rooms were linked the wrong way or made where you never went. Look no longer counts as a move.
'start mapping' while the map isn't sure where you are (among look-alike rooms) now warns you first and asks for 'here <roomID>'; type it again within 30 seconds to map anyway.

Dol Amroth: in The city and castle of Dol Amroth (overworld) 'nw' sends 'enter' to Outside the gate to the castle, and there 'se' sends 'out' back. The map draws the line between them (an arrow between the overworld and Dol Amroth), written by itself at login.
Smart exits: a pair of rules that lead to each other (like enter and out) now draws its line both ways, and 'sync exits' only writes what's missing.

The River Harnen: the whole land south of it (Harad, Umbar's coast) lay one row too far south; it moves up one row by itself at your first login, once (a copy of the map is saved first). A checkpoint near the River Harnen becomes its own area, the Mouth of River Harnen links straight south to the bank, and that bank is no longer marked as shallows. Right after, the few river-bank exits made before the move (now one row off) are pointed at the room beside them, so landing on the south bank puts the map in the right room again, and every exit into the river from the bank goes both ways.

Safer Harlond clean-up: it only removes the old copy rooms while the quays aren't linked yet. Mudlet gives the numbers of deleted rooms to new ones, and new water rooms near Pelargir got exactly those numbers (they were never touched, but now they can't be).

Boat around by double-clicking the map: in your boat, a double-click on a water room (or shallows) rows you there as one fast 'do', by water only. In the boat on the shore it launches first. Before, Mudlet said 'Cannot find a path' for every click on the water ('sp' and 'goto' already worked).
Swimming: map clicks, sp and goto don't walk at all while you swim (a few rooms and you drown); it tells you instead.

The Harlond quays are linked to the Anduin: Near the Quays of Harlond (Arda) northwest is The quays of Harlond (Harlond), shown as an arrow between the two maps. The copies earlier boat trips made there (four rooms) are removed by themselves.

Smoother by the rivers: the bank check on each step skips the ways already linked to their water room and remembers spots with no water room, instead of asking Mudlet to search the whole overworld (about 49,000 rooms) for them every time. At login the water rooms are only re-locked if they need it.

Fixed: in your boat, typing the direction of a landing the map knows now lands you ('do land se,disembark') even when the water room's title doesn't list that land (Nen Hithoel to The Plains). It sent a plain 'se' and the game said 'perhaps you could land there?'.

The Pelennor Fields trenches swap names ('A trench full of flames and smoke' / 'A deep trench, filled with smoke and ruin'): both now count as the same room, like Lothlorien and the Barad-dur stairs, so the map keeps up there.

Special rooms on the overworld (Arda) are red: every room with a way off the grid (enter, path, gate, village, up, down...) and every room whose plain direction leads into another area (a zone's entrance). The first login colors all of them once; a room turns red by itself when such an exit is learned there.
In the painted map those rooms glow red, like the rooms marked red by hand always did, with their road or bridge still drawn on top.
Fixed in the painted map: roads beside a river were painted as river (the southern Greenway at the Isen), and snowy peaks were drawn over the Isen south of it.

Walking along a river on foot links the bank to the water: every way the room title lists as water [ ] is joined to the water room there (if it's mapped), and that water room can land back on this bank. Walk both banks of a river once and its landings are all on the map. A short gray line says what was linked.

Fixed: with 'start mapping' on, anything you typed with 'enter <word>' in it (even a tell) could be saved as a special exit. Only commands that start with 'enter' count now, and talking (tell, say, emote, the comms) is never taken for an exit. The one such exit on the map (a tell at Rohan Plains 7148) is removed by itself.
Fixed: 3.5.0 could make the overworld (Arda) lag badly with the map pictures on. If you got 3.5.0, this fixes it.
The whole overworld is painted now: a small picture of all of Arda lies under the sharp pictures around you, so zoomed out the rest of the world isn't bare.
Right-clicking a room over the map pictures gives the room menu again (with Mudlet 5.1). If a click between rooms drags a picture off, 'mapbg on' puts it back.
Chat tabs: long tells, says and channel messages that the game splits over several lines now show as one line in their tab, and nothing else slips in after a tell.
Hybrid squares: where the map's land squares don't line up with the game's river, a water room now shares the square with the land room in the way, instead of not being mapped at all.
Logged in while on a river? The map knows you're on the water as soon as it puts you in a water room, and 'start mapping' pauses there too (it made one-way exits and copies of rooms on the water).

Water rooms show a white ≈. Shallows, a room you can both walk and boat in (a shore like 'Along the Great Sea', a bridge, a ford), turn turquoise with a ~ by themselves when you row or swim into one; 'mapshallows' marks the room you're in, 'mapshallows all' every room with its name.
Bridges are painted as one straight deck across the water instead of a plank to every exit.

Map clicks and sp on the water: in a boat (or swimming) the walk goes by water rooms and shallows only, along the ways the game lists as water, as one fast 'do'. A land room can't be reached by boat: it says so instead of sending a walk the boat can't do.

Boats in one go, just type the direction: with your boat on the ground, a water way sends 'board boat,launch <dir>' as one 'do'; in the boat on the water, a land way sends 'land <dir>,disembark'; in the boat on the shore, 'launch <dir>'; swimming, a water way sends 'swim <dir>'. Long words (west) work too.

Exits that answer with the long description and no title (Laketown's 'lake' out onto the Long Lake) are followed now: the map reads the 'There is water to...' and 'The only obvious exits are...' lines. Every 'lake' in Laketown is known to lead to the Long Lake: from a quay the map doesn't have it for yet, it follows you and remembers that exit. Elsewhere, where the map doesn't know the exit yet, it asks the game with a 'glance'.
'glance' in your boat on the water no longer makes the map think you're ashore (the game says 'You are in a rickety old boat.' on land and on water alike).
If the updater says there's no update address, it now says why (the OmiT2TPersonal package missing).

Fixed the freezes: the painted map pictures were saved inside the map file (70 MB with the overworld's), and Mudlet rewrote that file every few minutes. They're laid as temporary pictures now, never saved, so the map file stays small (about 9 MB).
On the overworld only the pictures around you are laid (3 or 4 instead of all 31), and a few are swapped in as you travel: far less memory, and the map redraws faster.
Following long stretches of look-alike rooms (travelto across the Rohan Plains) takes less work: each room is checked once per step.

Rivers go on the map as you swim or row: each water room you reach that the map doesn't have yet is added one step from where you were, named by its title, colored blue and linked to its banks. 'mapwater' shows how many there are, 'mapwater off' stops it, 'mapwater undo' removes the last one made.
Water rooms are locked: sp, goto and clicking the map still never take you through water (no drowning in a fight or with a heavy pack). Swimming and boating paths on request come later.

Moves on the water are followed: 'swim <dir>', 'launch <dir>', plain directions in a boat, 'land <dir>' back ashore. If the map wasn't sure which bank you set out from, it says so instead of guessing (then 'here <roomID>' on the bank).
No need for 'start mapping' on the water: if it's on when you swim or launch, it pauses (the stock mapper made one-way exits and copies of rooms there) and comes back on when you're on foot again.

A new way of following you on the map, made for The Two Towers. It counts every command and every step of a 'do' by the game's prompts, and finds each room by its name and its exits, so long runs of look-alike rooms (Rohan Plains, the Lebennin Road) no longer lose it.

The map follows moves the game makes for you: travelto, following a leader, game aliases. Among look-alike rooms it keeps every possibility and shows its best guess; where nothing tells them apart (open plains) it waits at the last room it was sure of.

Lothlorien: the game swaps a square's name between 'Lothlorien' and 'Near a guard flet', which threw mappers off. Both now count as the same room (on your Cerin Amroth walks the map was on the right square 497 times out of 504).
The spiral staircase in the Barad-dur tower: 'A dimly lit stairway', 'An ominous stairway' and 'A dark stairway' swap too and now count as the same room.

The drunk mug follows the game: every stage in 'score' (a bit tipsy, somewhat drunk, rather drunk, completely smashed, totally wasted, too drunk to remember your name), every step of sobering up, the headache, and sober again.
Disguises show on your portrait: after 'disguise race ...' or 'disguise profession ...' it shows the disguise with a mask badge, and 'score' no longer mistakes the disguise for your real race.
Room title colors are a hint only: another character with other colors still works, and you're reminded once to type 'mapsetup'.
A command that moved you where the map has no exit (search brush, press indentations) offers [remember it] to add that exit.

Swimming and boating are noticed: the map waits at the last land room and finds you again when you land (water rooms aren't on the map yet). Water titles without ( ), like the Ringlo rapids, are read now.
'spmode safe' walks one step at a time with our own walker; 'spstop' stops it.

Fast speedwalks, the T2T way: sp, goto and clicking the map send the whole path as one 'do' line, and the map keeps up room by room (special exits like 'enter' included: no more map stuck at the guildhall door). 'spmode safe' walks one step per room instead.
The map keeps up with your own 'do a,b,c' lines and with game aliases too: when it didn't follow a move, it finds you among the nearby rooms by name and exits.

Fixed: when the map lost track of you, the room it thought you were in could get the wrong color (the color of the room you were really in), and that was saved in the map. Now a room is only colored when the map agrees with the game.
Changed: 'deletearea' needs an area number (on its own it used to delete area 1).
New: 'mapsetup'. Room title colors are a game setting, so the mapper reads yours from the game's 'color' menu (it opens the menu, reads it and closes it for you). 'mapsetup show' shows them.
Fast walks: when a step fails, the rest of the 'do' still runs in the game; the map now follows it from where you really are.
Removed: the slow pulse of the HP/EP bars ('uitheme glow'). It restyled the bars about 13 times a second and could make Mudlet stutter; the bars now only change when your HP/EP color does.

New: 'debug on' shows a grey line after every room: the room the game shows next to the room the map thinks you're in (ID, exits), and says when they disagree. It also says when the mapper won't count a command as a move (like 'enter' in a room the map has no 'enter' exit for). 'debug quiet' writes it only into the rec log, 'debug off' stops.
Updates from inside Mudlet: new versions and maps are offered in a pop-up when you log in ('omiupdate' checks now). This is the last time you install the packages by hand.
Version number at the right end of the menu bar: click it for what's new and to check for updates.
Smart exits learn where they lead: 'sx n enter', then just go n. The map follows you and links the room you land in; 'sx s out' on the other side links the way back. No more 'spev'.
Session recorder (rec): every game line in colour, your commands and the rooms you pass go to omi_logs in your profile. Your login is never written. 'rec off' stops it until the next start.
Everything in one package, OmiT2T, plus OmiT2TPersonal (replaces the 7 old T2T packages).
Menu bar at the top left with a Help pad: every game help file, read offline after one 'helpcrawl'.
Touch friendly: 'uitouch on' makes the bar, buttons and text bigger.
Fewer freezes: the painted map lays only the current area's pictures.

map.notes: Omi's newest map (3 Nov, early morning): about 70 new water rooms: the Anduin at the Harad Road bridge, the Mouth of the Anduin, and the River Poros from the Anduin up to Kadar and on upstream past it, with the plains along its banks linked to the water. Kadar's river is joined to the overworld's at both ends, and Kadar's docks lead onto it. Everything in the last map (Harad Desert, River Harnen move, Dol Amroth gate) is still there.

pictures.notes: The 3D landscape for the 3D map: with 'map3d on' and 'mapbg on' the painted land stands up (hills, snowy mountains, forests, Mount Doom, Barad-dur). Same flat pictures as before otherwise.
